edit.subject: succeeded
edit.scope: Which relation holds in the reverse direction when one person succeeded another in an office.

direct.prompt: Is 'preceded' the inverse of the relation 'succeeded' (in an office)?

cross_lingual.prompt: 爱德华七世继维多利亚女王之后成为英国君主。能否由此推出维多利亚女王是爱德华七世之前的英国君主？
Eduardo VII sucedió a la reina Victoria como monarca del Reino Unido. ¿Se deduce que la reina Victoria precedió a Eduardo VII como monarca del Reino Unido?

unrelated_near.prompt: Is 'was founded by' the inverse of the relation 'founded'?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is older than' asymmetric?
